How CSCA live classes work

CSCA.ai live classes are teacher-led online courses in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry that follow the published CSCA syllabus. Open a subject to see its next batch, schedule and price.

Live online, in English

Classes run live online with a teacher, so you can join from anywhere and ask questions as they come up.

Built on the CSCA syllabus

Each course follows the published CSCA syllabus for its subject. Every class explains the core idea, works through exam-style questions step by step and leaves time for your questions.

Batches with their own recordings

Each batch is a separate cohort with its own schedule and recordings. Buying a batch gives you lifetime access to that batch's recordings.

Single subjects or bundles

Take Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry on its own, or combine subjects in a bundle that matches what your program requires.

Mathematics live classPhysics live classChemistry live class

CSCA live class questions

Are CSCA live classes online?

Yes. CSCA.ai live classes are taught live online in English, so you can join from any country and ask the teacher questions during the class.

Can I watch the class recordings?

Yes. Each batch has its own recordings, and buying a batch gives you lifetime access to that batch's recordings, so you can review a class you missed or revisit a topic before the exam.

Which live class should I take?

Mathematics is required for every CSCA applicant. Add Physics or Chemistry if your program asks for them: Chemistry is common for medicine and laboratory sciences, and Physics for engineering. Check your university's requirements first.

Do live classes replace practice tests?

No. Live classes teach the topics, and practice questions and timed mock tests build the speed you need for 48 questions in 60 minutes. Most students combine both.

Studying on your own? Start with the CSCA preparation guide and the free practice tests.
